mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_notice_outbox WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND next_retry_time IS NOT NULL AND next_retry_time <= #{now} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY next_retry_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_notice_outbox SET status = #{status}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
